title: Pip and the Storm-Sparrows
subtitle: A Small Bird and the Biggest Sky
blurb: Pip is the smallest sparrow in Thistlewick Hedge, and everyone reminds her of it. Only big, strong sparrows ever become Storm-Sparrows, the daring scouts who ride the autumn gales ahead of the flock. Pip decides to be one anyway. Then the great storm comes early, and the whole flock is scattered over the Grey Sea.
